serverInfo.name: Google-Agents
serverInfo.title: Google Agents
serverInfo.description: Create and delete Gemini Agents with simple primitive tools. GET discovery is exposed through MCP resources; use Google Agent Editor for complex environment and tool lists.

instructions: To create a minimal web-search managed agent, use google_agents_create with a unique id, googleWebSearch=true, and optional systemInstruction. baseAgent defaults to antigravity-preview-09-2026; omit model to use Google's default managed-agent model. gemini-2.5-flash is not supported for managed agents. File-based creation accepts complete JSON payloads at public HTTPS URLs; protected SharePoint and OneDrive files require delegated authentication. Google-AgentEditor requires Microsoft delegated authentication and assembles complex source, network, environment-variable, function, and MCP-server lists. Local validation does not guarantee Google API acceptance. The beta Google API documented here has no update endpoint.
